strings.name: Robin Li
strings.role: Baidu co-founder · Search and AI entrepreneur
strings.summary: Robin Li researched link analysis and page ranking before returning to China to co-found Baidu with Eric Xu. He helped develop commercial Chinese-language search and expanded the company into AI, cloud services and autonomous driving, including the ERNIE model family. Paid search and medical advertising also brought criticism and regulatory investigation, with the Wei Zexi case becoming a major turning point in debates over the platform's responsibilities.
strings.coverageNote: Research checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2026. This is not a daily news archive. Shared achievements are credited to collaborators and teams.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Baidu and developed Chinese-language search technology, participating in industrial applications of AI and autonomous driving.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Peking University information-management bachelor's (1991); University at Buffalo computer-science master's (1994)
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Search and link analysis
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Developed RankDex-related ranking technology and helped establish Baidu's Chinese-language search service.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: AI platform transition
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Expanded into speech, models, cloud computing and autonomous driving while facing responsibilities for advertising governance.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: AI organizations at Baidu World
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Discussed reorganizing businesses around AI and presented the company's new models and tools.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Introduced ERNIE Bot
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Presented the generative-AI product, bringing Baidu's language-model work to a wider public.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Medical-advertising investigation
strings.timeline.event-3.text: After the Wei Zexi case, regulators investigated Baidu; Li urged staff to reconsider user trust and profit.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Baidu's Nasdaq listing
strings.timeline.event-4.text: The company he co-founded listed in the United States, supporting a new phase of expansion.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Co-founded Baidu
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Founded Baidu with Eric Xu to develop search services for the Chinese-language web.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: RankDex ranking work
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Developed search-ranking methods using links between pages; the related patent was filed the following year.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Master's and information services
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Completed a Buffalo computer-science master's and joined IDD to work on information retrieval.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Peking University degree
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Earned an information-management bachelor's degree before studying computer science in the United States.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in Yangquan
